meta.name: video-inpainting
meta.description: Region edits across video frames on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — remove an object that appears across many frames, clean up wires or watermarks, replace a region with matching motion. Routes across Wan 2-7 edit-video (default, prompt-driven region edits with spatial language), Lucy Edit Restyle (identity-stable region-aware restyle), and Seedream 4-0 edit-sequential (when treating the clip as a frame stack). Picks the right route based on whether the change is prose-driven, identity-locked, or needs frame-by-frame still inpaint chained into a video. Triggers on "video inpaint", "video inpainting", "remove from video", "mask region in video", "clean up video", "remove object from clip", "video patch", "frame-by-frame edit", "remove watermark from video", "remove passing person", or any explicit ask to edit a region across video frames.

copy.tagline_en: Remove objects, watermarks, or edit regions in videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to remove objects or fix regions in video frames

howto.what: Claude 会通过 RunComfy 的 CLI 工具编辑视频中的指定区域，例如移除物体、清理电线或水印，并自动选择最合适的模型（Wan 2-7、Lucy Edit Restyle 或 Seedream 4-0）来处理。
howto.when: 当用户提出涉及视频区域编辑的请求时触发，例如要求移除视频中的物体、清理水印或替换区域。典型触发词包括“video inpaint”、“remove from video”、“clean up video”等。

say.text: 帮我移除这段视频右下角的水印。
把视频里那个穿红衣服的人去掉。
替换视频中天空为日落场景。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Wan 2-7 的提示驱动编辑。

howto.what_en: Claude edits a region across video frames via the RunComfy CLI — removes objects, cleans up wires or watermarks, replaces a region with matching motion. It automatically routes to the best model (Wan 2-7, Lucy Edit Restyle, or Seedream 4-0) based on the request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to edit a region in a video, such as removing an object, cleaning up a watermark, or replacing a region. Typical trigger phrases include "video inpaint", "remove from video", "clean up video", etc.

say_en.text: Remove the watermark in the bottom-right corner of this video.
say_en.note: Claude uses Wan 2-7 Edit-Video with spatial language.

say_en.text: Remove the person in red walking in the background.
say_en.note: Claude tries Wan 2-7 or a ComfyUI workflow for better results.

say_en.text: Replace the sky with a sunset in this video.
